description: DS-to-DS federation endpoint: deliver an MLS application message to a remote delivery service for local subscriber fanout.

main.description: Accept an inbound MLS message from a remote DS and store it for local subscribers. The caller must be the sequencer DS for the conversation. Authentication is via a service JWT whose issuer DID matches senderDsDid.

msgId.description: Unique message identifier (idempotency key for deduplication)

epoch.description: MLS epoch number when the message was encrypted

senderDsDid.description: DID of the sending delivery service (must match JWT issuer)

messageType.description: Message type hint (e.g. 'app', 'proposal'). Defaults to 'app' if omitted.

accepted.description: Whether the message was accepted and stored

ack.description: Optional cryptographic acknowledgement signed by the receiving DS

errors.name: ConversationNotFound
errors.description: The conversation does not exist on this DS

errors.name: NotSequencer
errors.description: The calling DS is not the sequencer for this conversation

errors.name: AuthFailed
errors.description: JWT validation failed or senderDsDid does not match JWT issuer

deliveryAck.description: Cryptographic receipt acknowledging message delivery, signed by the receiving DS.

epoch.description: The MLS epoch at the time of acknowledgement

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over (msgId, convoId, epoch)
